segments.text:
V. 29.
He ſ•eth J•ſus coming and ſaith, Behold the Lamb—Innocent; to be offered up; propheſied of by Iſaiah (ch. liii. 7.) typiſied by the Paſchal Lamb, and by the daily Sacrifice: The Lamb of God—Whom GOD gave, approves, accepts of; who taketh away—Atoneth for; the Sin—That is, all the Sins; of the world—Of all Mankind. Sin and the World are of equal Extent.
